sectors.note:
**TL;DR:** Energy and Technology remain the dominant leaders in a narrow market where only 2 of 11 sectors show positive momentum across all timeframes.

Market leadership remains heavily concentrated at the top. Energy commands the market with near-perfect momentum (0.967, rank 1 YTD) alongside Consumer Defensive (0.617, rank 5 YTD) as the only two all-green groups across weekly, monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, and YTD horizons. Sustained leadership is reinforced by Technology (0.783, rank 2 YTD), which joins Energy as a persistent top-3 performer across the 1-, 3-, and 6-month windows.

Rotations beneath the surface show slight defensive and communication positioning, while cyclical and rate-sensitive areas continue to fade. Consumer Defensive and Communication Services both gained +1 spot over the last five sessions, while Financial and Healthcare slipped -1 spot each. Lagging groups like Real Estate (0.233), Utilities (0.283), and Consumer Cyclical (0.300) remain anchored near the bottom with deteriorating momentum.

## Strength
- **Narrow Breadth:** Only 2 of 11 sectors are all-green across all measured timeframes (week, month, quarter, half, YTD): Energy (0.967) and Consumer Defensive (0.617).
- **Sustained Leaders:** Energy and Technology have maintained top-3 rank status consistently across the 1-, 3-, and 6-month horizons.
- **Top Momentum:** Energy leads all sectors with a 0.967 score, followed by Technology at 0.783.

## Movers & Momentum
- **Top 5-Session Gainers:** Communication Services gained +1 spot (momentum 0.550, rank 7) and Consumer Defensive advanced +1 spot (momentum 0.617, rank 5).
- **Top 5-Session Losers:** Healthcare slipped -1 spot to rank 6 (momentum 0.583), while Financial dropped -1 spot to rank 8 (momentum 0.350).
- **Persistent Laggards:** Consumer Cyclical sits at rank 11 with 0.300 momentum, while Real Estate marks the absolute momentum low at 0.233 (rank 9).

## Divergences
- **Leadership Polarization:** A wide momentum gap exists between leaders Energy (0.967) / Technology (0.783) and laggards Real Estate (0.233) / Utilities (0.283).
- **Rank and Momentum Decoupling:** Industrials holds a top-half rank position (rank 4 YTD) despite exhibiting laggard-tier momentum of 0.367.
- **Fragile Green Signals:** No sectors currently trigger early-warning divergence signals for unstable all-green leadership.

industries.note:
**TL;DR:** Energy and distribution retain market leadership with 23 all-green groups, while defensive and consumer staples show sharp short-term rank improvements against fading industrials and materials.

Traditional energy continues to dominate industry strength, led by Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing (momentum 1.000, rank 1 YTD) alongside Oil & Gas Integrated (0.927) and Marine Shipping (0.899). Breadth remains selective, with only 23 of 144 groups holding all-green status across all timeframes.

Rotational flows are pushing lower-ranked healthcare, consumer, and financial pockets upward over the last 5 sessions, headlined by Drug Manufacturers - Specialty & Generic (+33 spots to rank 83) and Beverages - Wineries & Distilleries (+16 spots to rank 69). Conversely, previous momentum pockets are fading rapidly, with Uranium dropping 23 spots to rank 119 and Aerospace & Defense falling 21 spots to rank 93.

## Strength
- **Dominant Energy Complex:** Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing holds the top overall momentum score at 1.000 (rank 1 YTD), backed by Oil & Gas Integrated (0.927 momentum, rank 8 YTD) and Oil & Gas E&P (0.868 momentum, rank 12 YTD).
- **Sustained Multitrack Leaders:** Marine Shipping (0.899 momentum, rank 5 YTD) and Electronics & Computer Distribution (0.852 momentum, rank 3 YTD) maintain top-36 ranks across 1-, 3-, and 6-month horizons.
- **Resilient All-Green Cohort:** Only 23 of 144 groups are positive across week, month, quarter, half, and YTD periods, with Copper (0.84 momentum), Consumer Electronics (0.84 momentum), and Diagnostics & Research (0.83 momentum) sustaining persistent strength.

## Movers & Momentum
- **Sharpest 5-Day Rank Advancers:** Drug Manufacturers - Specialty & Generic surged 33 spots to rank 83 (0.55 momentum), followed by Beverages - Wineries & Distilleries (+16 to rank 69, 0.71 momentum) and Credit Services (+15 to rank 81, 0.70 momentum).
- **Steepest 5-Day Decliners:** Uranium shed 23 spots to sink to rank 119 (0.11 momentum), Aerospace & Defense dropped 21 spots to rank 93 (0.34 momentum), and Agricultural Inputs slipped 16 spots to rank 48 (0.38 momentum).
- **Persistent Momentum Laggards:** Mortgage Finance (0.015 momentum, rank 142 YTD), Advertising Agencies (0.065 momentum, rank 144 YTD), and Airports & Air Services (0.068 momentum, rank 141 YTD) remain anchored at the bottom of the market.

## Divergences
- **Fading High-Momentum Groups:** Electronic Components (0.66 momentum), Scientific & Technical Instruments (0.65 momentum), and Drug Manufacturers - General (0.63 momentum) all lost 5 rank spots over the last 5 days despite elevated momentum profiles.
- **Emerging Low-Momentum Rebounds:** Grocery Stores (+9 rank spots, 0.45 momentum), Information Technology Services (+8 rank spots, 0.47 momentum), and Consulting Services (+7 rank spots, 0.34 momentum) are posting notable 5-day rank gains before their baseline momentum scores have recovered.
